notes: Every session now records a full event log: each press (and whether it was a click, the shortcut or the --log command), pauses with their real times, undos and how the session ended.
Export CSV on the History tab saves a sessions file and an events file, for all sessions or just the ones you select.
CSV copies of all sessions are kept up to date automatically in the csv folder inside your history folder.
Dark theme that follows your system's light/dark setting, with a Light/Dark override in Settings.
The floating dot has its own colour setting: Match system, Light or Dark.
Built-in updater: checks GitHub at startup and asks before installing a newer version.
